title: Asset-extension location rule beside a server_tokens violation; the rule captures no real route

planted_violations.description: server_tokens on; docs/nginx-hardening.md H-1 requires off

notes: Control for case-004 (issue #67). The location rule is the same, but docs/routes.md R-1 makes every :version a UUID with no dot, so the rule captures nothing the SPA serves and the worker must report nothing for it, at most a low-severity note. EVAL_PINS turns routing_probe off, which removes the Matching rules prompt section (#67), so an eval run does not exercise that rule. The decoy has no expected entry; a finding that blames the location rule is an unmatched AI finding.
